scope.cost_precision: Real returned 384D FP16 vectors, FP32 native scores
scope.joint_quality: The same live 16-query per-corpus calls and fused Top100; mixed calibration/reused-outer cohort
scope.throughput: Completed queries divided by actual sequential batch wall time; not reciprocal mean latency or server capacity
scope.p95: Descriptive pooled 48-execution percentile; not an independent-query tail confidence interval
scope.stage_clocks: Nested diagnostics; never summed into endpoint latency
scope.network: Actual TCP streaming proxy; 100Mbps each direction, 20ms configured RTT; application framing only
scope.inference: Exploratory frozen-model/cohort comparisons; no equivalence or privacy claim

separate_cached_quality.scope: Separate 9005 reused-outer cached FP32 quality study; not the same calls/precision as live joint quality and cost.
